messages:
anya: Quick ask  Can we add a compact cost-preview card when hovering SKUs in Console? show estimated delta for token cost + cache savings if switching routing policy.

sam: Yes please. would cut down on surprise billing during rollouts. :thumbsup:

pranav: We can do it but need to surface sample_rate and a variance indicator. cache savings depend on sequence-shape distribution.

katie: UX: headline (rounded $/day), small expand for per-model lines, and a tiny 'view assumptions' link. hide GPU time under advanced.

maria: Ops constraint: avoid extra load during large rollouts. we should cache previews for 60s and rate-limit per-user. also need per-org opt-out flag.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: recommend 60s LRU cache on internal preview service, include X-Internal-Key, max 32k keys.

sam: API sketch: GET /internal/console/cost_preview?route=R&policy=sticky&window=7d returns model_summaries, token_delta_pct, est_cost_delta_unit, sample_rate, decision_id, freshness_flag. UI formats currency.

pranav: include warmup projection for sticky routing (0-24h). short-term negative delta is real and must be shown.

katie: we'll mock a 24h sparkline for warmup. headline will say "est. $0.4/day (±20%)" and expand shows cache vs model-run.

maria: action items: eng prototype API + cache; frontend hovercard mock; product finalize copy & confidence language; ops add feature-flag and throttle rules. I'll open GH issue.

anya: perfect, thanks. please tag me on the PRs so we can align copy and assumptions.
